editions.title: Tesla's Roadster flies, chip stocks slump and Apple's Duo sells out
editions.intro: Tesla unveiled its long-delayed second-generation Roadster at a SpaceX test site in Texas, a showcase that quickly fuelled talk of a Tesla-SpaceX merger. Chip stocks had their longest losing streak since 2006, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 12% over seven days. Apple's foldable iPhone Duo sold out on pre-order, pushing delivery estimates into 2027, while AI-driven market jitters and a hot inflation backdrop kept Fed expectations in focus.

top_stories.title: Tesla shows Roadster built with SpaceX tech, merger talk grows
top_stories.summary: Tesla showed its next-generation Roadster in McGregor, Texas, with SpaceX thrusters used in a flip-and-hover stunt. Musk targets production in 2028 with no price confirmed. Barclays suggested a Tesla-SpaceX deal could come before the end of 2026.

top_stories.title: Longest chip selloff since 2006 wipes out billions
top_stories.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell over 12% in a week and was on course for an eighth straight loss. Short sellers gained an estimated $32 billion in paper profits, per S3 Partners.

top_stories.title: Big Tech suffers worst week since 'liberation day'
top_stories.summary: The FT reports Big Tech shares had their steepest weekly decline since the April sell-off, with AI-trade jitters pushing money into government debt. The rotation also halted a months-long Treasury sell-off.

top_stories.title: Traders expect Fed hold, but Warsh could surprise
top_stories.summary: Futures priced about a 15% chance of an October hike. CPI is up 3.7% and PPI 6.3% year on year to September, and Hoenig said inflation could climb further, keeping a hike in play.

top_stories.title: Galaxy S27 may drop Qualcomm chip over overheating
top_stories.summary: A Seoul Economic Daily report says the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheats in Samsung testing, and Samsung may use its Exynos 2700 if Qualcomm cannot fix it. Talks are ongoing and the report remains unconfirmed.

top_stories.title: Concern DOJ settlement with Apple is too weak
top_stories.summary: The Information reports DOJ settlement talks with Apple over iPhone interoperability, with developers such as PayPal and Epic worried the terms are too light. Neither side has confirmed details.

top_stories.title: China drafts tighter AI export controls
top_stories.summary: A draft update covers 23 AI technologies, including a ban on AI tools that autonomously write malware for critical infrastructure attacks. Open-weight models are also brought into scope, but the draft is not final.

rumour_watch.note: Bloomberg says SoftBank is weighing a deal for Allied Universal at up to $18bn; credible sourcing but talks are early and no agreement exists.
A 28 October touchscreen MacBook reveal is echoed by a separate iPad mini folio filing, so the event timing has some support, though still unconfirmed by Apple.
Overheating reports from two outlets point to real testing problems, but the scope is unclear and Samsung has not confirmed a switch.
A secondhand report of an NBA and sportsbook agreement lacks confirmation from either party, so treat as unverified.

stocks_to_watch.name: Nvidia
stocks_to_watch.note: Caught in the chip selloff, though RTX Spark devices went on sale and Jensen Huang said the sell-off will pass.

stocks_to_watch.name: Tesla
stocks_to_watch.note: Roadster reveal and SpaceX merger talk lift sentiment, while a reported energy chief exit and an FSD crash add risk.

stocks_to_watch.name: Apple
stocks_to_watch.note: iPhone Duo demand is strong but supply is tight into 2027, and the DOJ settlement and a possible touchscreen MacBook are in play.

stocks_to_watch.name: Samsung Electronics
stocks_to_watch.note: Possible Qualcomm chip switch and a mobile division set for an annual loss weigh, while its chip arm profits from memory prices.

stocks_to_watch.name: Qualcomm
stocks_to_watch.note: Reported overheating in its 2nm flagship chip could cost it a major Samsung design win.

stocks_to_watch.name: SoftBank Group
stocks_to_watch.note: A reported bid for Allied Universal of up to $18bn fits Son's AI robotics push but is not agreed.

in_brief.line: Google's Gemini 4 Argon hit 97.5% on ARC-AGI-3 under a vendor setup, but only 49.8% under the standard harness.
China's CXMT expects a nine-month net profit of about 131-132.5bn yuan, against a loss a year earlier, on AI-driven DRAM demand.
Nvidia's RTX Spark laptops are on sale from $2,599, including Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra, with most shipping on 16 October.
Anthropic gives METR evaluators employee-like access and will let them publish findings, as the FTC subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic.
Microsoft's Brad Smith criticises a green-card sponsorship suspension affecting Microsoft and seven other firms, including Infosys and Wipro.
The BIPM will stop adding leap seconds from May 2027, ending the risk of a first negative leap second.
Volkswagen is recalling several thousand EVs including the ID.4 over battery cells that fail quality checks; owners should cap charging at 80%.
Ramp confirmed a $1.85bn raise at a $60bn valuation and says it passed $2bn in annualised revenue.

editions.title: Apple's Duo sells out as Tesla Roadster sparks merger talk
editions.intro: Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, opened for pre-orders at $1,999, but shipping estimates slipped to January 2027 within hours. Tesla unveiled its long-delayed Roadster at a SpaceX test site, reviving speculation about a Tesla-SpaceX merger. Markets were jittery, with the Nasdaq down more than 2% and US deficit and Treasury yield worries back in focus.

top_stories.title: iPhone Duo pre-orders open, stock sells out
top_stories.summary: Apple's foldable starts at $1,999 and passes $3,000 at the top storage tier. Launch-day pickup stock sold out and delivery estimates have slipped into late January, which Apple called extraordinary demand. IDC forecasts about 7 million units this year.

top_stories.title: Tesla unveils Roadster, fuelling merger talk
top_stories.summary: The next-generation Roadster flew, flipped and hovered using SpaceX-derived thrusters at a McGregor, Texas event. Production is targeted for 2028 with no price confirmed. Barclays suggests a Tesla-SpaceX deal could come before the end of 2026.

top_stories.title: Prediction markets price a Tesla-SpaceX merger
top_stories.summary: Odds of a merger before March rose to 56% from 29% after a Barclays note set out how a combination could work. The move is a market signal rather than a confirmed plan, and both companies are controlled by Elon Musk.

top_stories.title: Galaxy S27 may drop Qualcomm chip over overheating
top_stories.summary: Reports say the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheats in Samsung testing and Samsung is weighing its own Exynos 2700. Samsung and Qualcomm are reportedly talking this month, and Samsung has not confirmed any change.

top_stories.title: US fiscal 2026 deficit hits $1.99 trillion
top_stories.summary: The deficit rose about 12% from the prior year and is the third-largest annual gap on record. Net interest topped $1 trillion, and Supreme Court-linked customs refunds added pressure. A CNBC analysis links it to 5%+ long-term Treasury yields.

top_stories.title: China drafts tighter AI export controls
top_stories.summary: A draft catalogue update would cover 23 AI technologies, including a total ban on tools that autonomously write malware for critical infrastructure attacks. Companies must register affected exports while the draft is not final.

top_stories.title: Trump says White House did not order Starlink curbs
top_stories.summary: Trump said the White House did not restrict Ukraine's Starlink use, and that Musk was not responsible. Ukrainian officials blamed SpaceX for cutting Starshield access, and SpaceX shares fell about 11% this week before Tuesday's results.

rumour_watch.note: Credible-sounding and sourced to Seoul Economic Daily, with a clear fallback plan, but it remains a 45% rumour until Samsung or Qualcomm comments.
Market odds reflect trader enthusiasm after one analyst note; no filing or board action exists, so treat the merger as speculative.
A regulatory filing for a new iPad mini folio is a concrete clue, though it does not confirm an OLED model or the 27-28 October event date.
Reported secondhand and not confirmed by the parties, though a separate NBA memo item suggests the league is tightening bet types.

stocks_to_watch.name: Apple
stocks_to_watch.note: Duo demand is strong, but delivery slips and supply questions weigh on the launch story.

stocks_to_watch.name: Qualcomm
stocks_to_watch.note: Reported overheating in its 2nm flagship chip could cost Samsung business.

stocks_to_watch.name: Tesla
stocks_to_watch.note: Roadster reveal and merger odds lift interest, but the car has no price and a 2028 date.

stocks_to_watch.name: Samsung Electronics
stocks_to_watch.note: Chip-supply and phone-cut reports cut both ways for the group.

stocks_to_watch.name: Nvidia
stocks_to_watch.note: RTX Spark laptops are now on sale, with most devices shipping on 16 October.

in_brief.line: The Nasdaq Composite and Nasdaq 100 both fell more than 2% on Friday as growth stocks sold off.
China's CXMT expects a nine-month profit of about 131-132.5 billion yuan on surging DRAM prices.
Nvidia's RTX Spark laptops are on sale from Best Buy, Microsoft, Asus, Lenovo, HP and Dell, priced from $2,599.
Google's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5% on ARC-AGI-3 in a vendor setup, but 49.8% under the standard harness.
Microsoft's Brad Smith criticised a US decision suspending eight firms from sponsoring green cards for foreign workers.
Netflix named Peter Rice, a former Disney executive, as chief content officer days after cutting about 1,000 jobs.
Kroger plans to cut about 3,000 corporate roles, or 37% of its corporate staff, over three years.
MI5 is opening an AI Threat Assessment Centre, and OpenAI told MPs more AI incidents may come.
